about: Blender camera moves for blender/film_blender.py (guide: docs/CHARACTER-BLENDER.md). Every move is an arc around the hero: az = degrees around him (0 = in front of him, 90 = his left, 180 = behind), dist = metres, height = lens height, look = height of the point the lens aims at, fov = vertical degrees. A pair [a, b] moves from a to b over the beat. basis: hero0 = his facing when the beat starts, hero = follows his facing, world = fixed. breathe = the lens moves in with the blade's speed (0.3 = up to 30% closer). lead = aims ahead of his travel.

circle.note: a full circle that rises: for slow motion and for the stillness after a kill

half-circle.note: from behind him to his front while the action is slow: the cut happens as the lens arrives

come-back.note: coming back: starts on the face or the blade, pulls away fast, then settles wide (after an impact)

go-front.note: going front: swings from his side to straight in front and closes in (before the strike)

push-pull.note: the lens breathes with the blade: in on every cut, back out as it settles

low-hero.note: low angle, slow push-in: the reference videos' hero shot

high-crane.note: cranes up and away: landing, aftermath, loneliness

top-down.note: straight down, slowly rolling: the cut as a line drawn on the ground

side-track.note: knee-height profile, racing with a dash; aims ahead of him

over-shoulder.note: behind his shoulder: what he sees, the target small ahead

blade-close.note: close on the hands and the steel

jump-under.note: from under a jump, turning: he passes over the lens

dash-test.note: calm before the storm: low push-in
the dash: knee-height profile racing with him
time slows on the cut: the lens goes front
skid: coming back, the falling tree behind him
squash and take-off from the ground
slow motion: circling under and over the aerial cut
zanshin and chiburi: the lens breathes with the blade
